title: Mashpia Celebrates Son's Upsherin
body: Rav Ephraim Fishel Yisrael Weinberger, Av Beis Din of Turka, marked a milestone with the upsherin of his 3-year-old son, born after 34 years of marriage.

title: Zurich Gets New Eruv
body: Jewish residents of Zurich celebrated their first Shabbos with a fully halachic eruv encircling the city's Jewish neighborhoods, joining a growing list of cities worldwide.

title: Rabbi Kluger Bids Farewell
body: Rabbi Binyomin Kluger, a 77-year-old Chassid of Sanz, ended his 50-year writing career with Hamodia, marking the occasion with a farewell column. He is a resident of Yerushalayim.
